name: Disc / Saucer
desc: The archetype: a domed, rotationally symmetric disc. Reported hovering in silence, then departing at implausible speed.

name: Black Triangle
desc: A large, silent, matte-black triangle with a light at each corner. The signature craft of the modern era.

name: Tic Tac / Cylinder
desc: A smooth, wingless capsule with no visible propulsion or flight surfaces. Defined by the Nimitz encounter.

name: Orb / Sphere
desc: A self-luminous sphere, often small and highly manoeuvrable — the most commonly reported modern form.

name: Cigar
desc: A long cylindrical craft, sometimes reported releasing smaller objects. A staple of the earliest sightings.

name: Chevron / Boomerang
desc: A wide V or boomerang — often a rank of lights holding perfect formation, gliding slow and silent.

name: Egg / Ovoid
desc: A seamless oval, frequently tied to electromagnetic effects — stalled engines and dead headlights.

name: Diamond
desc: An angular, faceted craft, occasionally reported venting flame and shadowed by conventional aircraft.

name: Bell / Acorn
desc: A small acorn- or bell-shaped object, famously linked to a rumoured military recovery in Pennsylvania.

name: Saturn / Hat
desc: A sphere or dome girdled by a broad ring — one of the more frequently photographed classic forms.

name: Cross / Plus
desc: A cruciform craft — two booms or ranks of light crossing at right angles. A recurring form in the British and European waves.

name: Delta / Flying Wing
desc: A swept, wing-like delta with no fuselage or tail — closer to a stealth flying wing than a flat triangle.

name: Sphere Cluster
desc: Not one craft but many — a formation of orbs or lights moving together, splitting apart and re-forming.
